lines.text: With the wall rebuilt and the doors set, Nehemiah put Hanani in charge and ordered the gates kept shut until the sun was hot.
The city was large but had few people, so God moved Nehemiah to gather the people and he found the register of those who first returned.
The register listed those who came up from captivity in Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar and returned each to his own town.
Priests who could not find their family records were excluded as unclean, and the king ordered them not to eat the most holy things.
The whole assembly numbered 42,360, and the Israelites all moved inside Jerusalem's walls to live by the seventh month.
